_comment: Object keys and whether the server stores an object under them (backend/internal/storage/storagepath, ValidateKey). A key is segments separated by '/', none of them empty, '.' or '..': no leading or trailing '/', no '//'. The server, and both SDKs' fakes, refuse every key under refused as INVALID_ARGUMENT where an object is created; an empty key is not listed, as a caller that names none gets one from the server.
